title: Hannah Fry Wins the Leelavati Prize in 2026 for Mathematics Outreach
summary: Professor Hannah Fry, a renowned mathematician and science communicator at Cambridge University, has won the prestigious Leelavati Prize in 2026 for her exceptional contributions to mathematics outreach. The award recognizes her work in making complex mathematical concepts accessible and engaging to the general public through various media platforms.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of communicating complex mathematics to lay audiences and inspiring public interest in mathematics.
why_valuable: Highlights the critical importance of science communication and public engagement in mathematics, recognizing efforts that bridge the gap between academic mathematics and public understanding.
